Posted 2026-09-09 ~09:00 IST via scheduled agent. Thread URL: https://x.com/ungalsoththu/status/2097532010155655637

Items (agency tags + sources)

  1. [MTC] 100 diesel buses (~7 yrs old, decent condition) to be converted to electric on GCC (gross cost contract) model; charging infrastructure at Attanthangal depot (Red Hills): ₹13.60 crore. — The Hindu, Sep 8 — https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/chennai/tn-govt-to-modernise-eight-bus-terminals-and-depots-in-the-state/article71443206.ece
  2. [TNSTC] 'Singara Chennai' NCMC card (MTC-only today) extended to ALL TN government buses statewide. — The Hindu, Sep 8 — same URL.
  3. [TNSTC] 8 bus terminals & depots (35.03 acres) to be redeveloped on PPP model; projected ₹124.28 crore/year non-ticket revenue. — The Hindu, Sep 8 — same URL.
  4. [TNSTC] Special buses to bridge last-mile gap for 19,000 students across 140 schools; Road Safety Innovation Hub at IIT-M as operating base. — New Indian Express, Sep 9 — https://www.newindianexpress.com/states/tamil-nadu/2026/Sep/09/special-tn-govt-buses-to-bridge-last-mile-gap-for-19000-kids
  5. [TNSTC] Vehicle location tracking devices + panic buttons in 13,490 buses: ₹17.99 crore. — The Hindu, Sep 8 — same URL as (1).
  6. [CMRL] ₹35.97-crore consultancy agreement: AECOM–Nippon Koei JV appointed PMC for Phase-1 network capacity enhancement (design, tendering, construction supervision, technical assistance). — Rail Analysis, Sep 8 — https://railanalysis.in/metro/cmrl-signs-consultancy-agreement-with-aecom-nippon-jv-as-pmc-for-phase-1-network-capacity-enhancement-project (also covered by Hindu Tamil Thisai, Sep 8)
  7. [CMRL] Tunnelling for 900-metre Royapettah–Thousand Lights twin tunnels (hard-rock terrain) to finish by end-October. — The Hindu, Sep 8 — https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/chennai/chennai-metro-rail-to-complete-tunnelling-work-from-royapettah-to-thousand-lights-next-month/article71438775.ece

Context: Items 1–5 are from Transport Minister's Assembly demand-for-grants announcements (Sep 8).
